name: @orbit/shared
//: The `exports` map ships compiled CommonJS + types so the Node server can consume the package directly. Bundlers (Vite/Vitest) resolve `@orbit/shared` to the TypeScript sources via an explicit alias defined in apps/web/vite.config.ts, so the sources stay the single source of truth.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "require('node:fs').writeFileSync('dist/package.json', JSON.stringify({ type: 'commonjs' }, null, 2))"
